lines.quote: After a lead change, the message shows an Undo button and stays 5 seconds, held open while hovered.

Board View.setup_readback: toast read back with an Undo button 10 ms after the drop
Board View.observed: message "… assigned to … Undo" with Undo + Dismiss; gone 5.04 s after it showed; still there after 15 s hovered, gone 8.8 s after the pointer left

Tech View.setup_readback: toast read back after the More actions > Reassign lead technician change
Tech View.observed: message with Undo + Dismiss; closed between 4.6 s and 5.5 s after the change (bracketing 5 s); still there after 15 s hovered

lines.quote: Undo puts the work order back exactly as it was: the previous lead technician (or Unassigned), its previous place in that technician's order, and any shifts the change cleared.

Board View.setup_readback: column order read before (W1,W2,W3) and after refresh; lead read from the work order
Board View.observed: W2 back between W1 and W3 with its old lead after Undo and after refresh; a work order that was Unassigned goes back to Unassigned (C847734)

Tech View.setup_readback: group order read before/after and after refresh; lead read from the work order
Tech View.observed: W2 back between W1 and W3 in Ana's group, also after refresh; a work order that was Unassigned goes back to Unassigned (lead "none")

lines.quote: Removed shifts come back as they were; a shift ended at the moment of the change gets its original end time back.

Board View.setup_readback: shifts read from the Schedule: today 08:45-11:45 (under way, location time 09:16) and tomorrow 08:00-12:00
Board View.observed: Clear shifts ended today's shift at 09:16 and removed tomorrow's; Undo gave back 08:45-11:45 and tomorrow 08:00-12:00 exactly

Tech View.observed: Clear shifts ended it at 09:17 and removed tomorrow's; Undo gave both back exactly

lines.quote: Each labor line goes back to the technician it had before the change, and a line that had none goes back to none (Undo does not apply the normal lead-change line rules).

Board View.setup_readback: line technicians read before: line 1 none, line 2 Ben, line 3 (complete) none
Board View.observed: after the change line 1 followed the new lead; after Undo line 1 none, line 2 Ben, line 3 none — as before

Tech View.observed: after Undo exactly as before (line with none back to none)

lines.quote: Undo is itself a lead change: it records its own audit entry.

Board View.setup_readback: work order Audit Log opened after the Undo
Board View.observed: entries: lead Ana → Ben (change) and Ben → Ana (Undo)

Tech View.setup_readback: Audit Log of the Tech View work order
Tech View.observed: entries: lead none → Ana (change) and Ana → none (Undo)

lines.quote: Undo follows the Invoiced or Paid rule (an invoiced or paid work order can't be moved back).

Board View.setup_readback: work order status read back Invoiced before Undo
Board View.observed: Undo refused: alert "Couldn’t undo the change. Move the work order back by hand." (plus the Invoiced reason); stays with the new lead after refresh

Tech View.observed: same alert; stays in the new lead's group after refresh

Board View.setup_readback: the shift question was shown on the change (read back), so shifts existed

lines.quote: After Undo, the message reads "Assignment undone", with no Undo button on it.

Board View.setup_readback: messages read every 100 ms for 4 s after Undo
Board View.observed: "Assignment undone" at 0.23 s with only Dismiss (no Undo); work order back with Ana

Tech View.observed: "Assignment undone" at 0.35 s with only Dismiss

lines.quote: If Undo can't be saved, nothing changes and the alert "Couldn’t undo the change. Move the work order back by hand." shows.

Board View.setup_readback: the Undo save (POST …/lead-change-undo) was made to fail with a server error
Board View.observed: alert "Couldn’t undo the change. Move the work order back by hand."; lead and column unchanged after refresh

Tech View.observed: same alert; group unchanged after refresh
